title: Flux 2 Klein 4B relight
description: Relight one reference image with the installed Flux 2 Klein 4B FP8 model. Reuses the qualified flux2-klein-edit graph unchanged; mood presets and the browser light guide write a lighting instruction into the edit prompt. Each generation is a separate run with its own Slate.

controls.label: Edit prompt
controls.default: Keep the subject, wardrobe and composition exactly as in the reference image.

values.prompt: Relight the scene with warm low golden-hour sunlight from one side, soft long shadows and gentle warm highlights. Keep the subject, wardrobe and composition exactly as in the reference image.
Relight the scene as high-contrast black-and-white noir, one hard key light and deep dramatic shadows. Keep the subject, wardrobe and composition exactly as in the reference image.
Relight the scene as a quiet night with cool moonlight, soft ambient fill and deep but readable shadows. Keep the subject, wardrobe and composition exactly as in the reference image.
Relight the scene as a neutral studio with a large softbox and even fill, clean soft shadows and natural skin tones. Keep the subject, wardrobe and composition exactly as in the reference image.

evidence: Graph reused unchanged from native-workflows/flux2-klein-angles/template.api.json, which was qualified against ComfyUI 0.37.0 object_info and produced a real 1024x1024 PNG on 2026-10-19.
Relight-specific E2E, identity fidelity and arbitrary-aspect behaviour are not proven yet; the app records each attempt as its own run and Slate.
